findings.entity: man's original coffee mug (mug A) vs. newly placed mug (mug B)
findings.description: From 01:10 to 01:12.5 two distinct white mugs are on the counter: mug A held in the man's hands and mug B under the waitress's right hand. As the waitress slides mug B toward him, the two mugs converge and by 01:13-01:14 only one mug remains at the man's hands. The waitress's hands hold only the plate afterward (01:15-01:17) and the man's hands hold one mug, so nothing visibly removes the second mug; one mug effectively merges into/disappears into the other.
